name: Wild West Bonanza

features.name: Assured-trigger buy
features.description: The bonus buy ensures a 4+ scatter trigger on the next spin.

review:
The Bonanza formula on the frontier – cowboy boots, hats, pistols, and gunshots and galloping horses in the sound. Refilling reels, pay anywhere.

A multiplier symbol lands in free spins with a random value from 2x to 100x. Chance x2 makes four scatters easier. High volatility, 15,000x max and 96% RTP. Free spins average around once every 395 spins. If you want a western Bonanza, this is it.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 395 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
